summary: Phase 4 implementation is functionally correct: production gate passes (197/197 wrappers documented, 0 missing), self-test fails by design (5 declarations, 3 missing including skip-like symbol), saveCardsHandler @returns is present, all 81 production throw sites have @throws (review-A inline-throw catch is intact), sibling typed-params guard remains green, lint/tsc/test/doctor all pass. Adversarial probing found two real defects in the guard (single-line JSDoc detection gap and A4 vacuous-pass for zero-declaration directory scope) — both fixed in this same pass before returning, plus a stale help-text expected count corrected. No regressions to the existing bad fixture (still fails 1, 5/3).
nonblocking_findings: Production code uses no single-line JSDocs on exported wrappers (verified by grep across apps/integrated-math-3/convex and apps/integrated-math-3/lib) so the single-line JSDoc detection bug was latent — now fixed for future-proofing.

The bad-sample fixture's runner-plumbing self-test message in the guard's FAIL output previously read 'missing_jsdoc=2, declarations=4' (stale from an earlier fixture draft) — corrected to 'missing_jsdoc=3, declarations=5' to match the actual fixture and test-strategy §9.3.
RC-P4-01 (99 wrapper @returns use Promise<unknown>) is documented API quality debt, not a spec violation — already recorded in review-c-phase4.json.

Production code does not use multi-line `export const X \n = internalQuery(...)` patterns, type-asserted wrappers `as any`, generic wrappers `<T>`, indented top-level wrappers, or `export default` of wrappers — the guard's regex-only approach is sufficient for the current code style. Documented limit per test-strategy §9.7.

fixes_applied.title: Single-line JSDoc detection gap
fixes_applied.description: The guard's line-state machine checked `/**` (block start) before `*/` (block end). For a single-line `/** doc */`, the block-start test matched and continued without setting prev_close, so any wrapper preceded by a single-line JSDoc was incorrectly reported as missing. Added a single-line JSDoc detection step BEFORE the block-start test: if the line starts with `/**`, ends with `*/`, and is on one line, treat it as both start and end, set prev_close=1, and continue. Verified: P8 probe now correctly reports missing_jsdoc=0 for `/** Single line JSDoc. */` + 1 wrapper; P3 probe now correctly reports missing_jsdoc=1 (1 documented + 1 undocumented) instead of missing_jsdoc=2.

fixes_applied.title: Vacuous-pass defense for zero-declaration directory scope
fixes_applied.description: test-strategy.md §9.8 A4 requires the guard to exit 3 (misuse) when zero files are scanned, but the existing exit-3 logic only triggers on 'no .ts/.tsx files in scope' or 'scope path not found'. A directory like apps/integrated-math-3/lib or apps/integrated-math-3/components (full of valid TS files but zero Convex wrappers) silently returned pass=true with declarations=0. Added a HAS_DIR_SCOPE tracker and an exit-3 block that fires when DECL_TOTAL=0 and HAS_DIR_SCOPE=1. The runner-plumbing single-file fixture path is exempt (HAS_DIR_SCOPE stays 0) so the bad-sample fixture still produces the expected missing_jsdoc=3/declarations=5/exit=1. Verified: SCOPE_DIRS=apps/integrated-math-3/lib now exits 3 with clear 'wrong directory' message; SCOPE_DIRS=apps/integrated-math-3/components exits 3; production gate and bad fixture are unchanged.

fixes_applied.title: Stale expected-count in FAIL output
fixes_applied.description: The guard's FAIL-mode help text printed 'Expected: missing_jsdoc=2, declarations=4, exit 1' but the actual fixture (and test-strategy §9.3) reports missing_jsdoc=3 / declarations=5. Corrected to match the real fixture and the test-strategy contract.
